subject: Review + land: mac/ponytail-native-cuts (41b5ad87) - Ponytail native cuts part 1; ECC full evaluation is on Alpha with seven backlog rows for your surfaces; one parity finding for your decision
body: Branch mac/ponytail-native-cuts, one commit 41b5ad87 off Alpha db546c8b, pushed. What it does: the identity-provider registry retired per the Ponytail yagni item - MDM/MFA/Hybrid stubs, saml/custom, the factory -> an exhaustive two-arm switch (oidc | control_plane_session); an unrecognised IDENTITY_PROVIDER_TYPE constructs NO provider and is named in the audit record (the old code fell silently to the template config); the configuration service's dead surface (presets, updaters, SecurityConfig/BackendConfig and their env reads) removed with getConfiguration kept for its live LockedIdleView caller; setup.sh and run-code-analysis.sh deleted; mobile theme sgBackground corrected to #15181B (row 104). Byte-faithful files untouched. 11 files, +293/-1247. Verified on the Mac: xcodebuild TEST SUCCEEDED 76/76 twice, swiftlint clean, ios gates green, preflight PASSED 245, breadth PASSED 56 on the branch. Landing on Alpha in the same push as this mail: docs/agent/ECC_FULL_EVALUATION_2026-09-01.md (the owner-directed six-stage run - 0 Critical/High/Medium, 3 Low unreachable, 0 server errors in 3,245 fuzzed requests, the v1 contract under-documents the server's fail-closed refusals), its INDEX row, and seven backlog rows under ECC full evaluation - five on your surfaces (webauthn store dual write, stepUpStore id logging, OIDC rate-limit keying, v1-openapi.yaml precision, legacy openapi.yaml drift), one Mac (Ponytail part 2), one for your decision: the AppWorkflows port lacks the TS per-action step-up release and check-decision-port-parity compares shape only, so it cannot see it - a golden-rule file, so the re-port and the gate extension are yours to decide. Three of your messages acked with status; Fleet/Headwind stays open (needs live servers; the Premium branch needs the owner's key or the 2026-09-16 deferred mark per DR-005). The native-ledger branch is fully superseded by #385 and later - nothing undelivered; LOOP.md no longer lists it.
